_note: Goal-driven pattern using existing QSM primitives — not a schema extension. Intent orients → Needs define targets → Actions move toward them → Observation records outcomes → Adaptation updates assumptions. This is a configuration of the standard, not an extension of it.

context.name: Solo Consulting Practice — Q2 2026
context.scope: Independent consulting practice: client delivery, business development, and practice operations

intent.label: Q2 2026 practice orientation
intent.statement: Grow the practice sustainably by deepening two anchor client relationships, launching a repeatable workshop offering, and protecting recovery time so delivery quality does not erode.
intent._note: Intent declares desired end state and orientation — not a task list. Needs carry the measurable targets; Actions carry the work.

needs.label: Mastery — delivery excellence
needs.target: Maintain client satisfaction ≥ 4.5/5 across active engagements through Q2; zero missed milestone deliveries

needs.label: Purpose — workshop offering
needs.target: Pilot workshop delivered to at least one paying client by 2026-06-30; post-session NPS ≥ 40

needs.label: Autonomy — sustainable capacity
needs.target: Average billable week ≤ 32 hours through Q2; at least one full recovery day per week

records.summary: Accepted anchor client as workshop pilot partner instead of waiting for a new prospect

details.decision: Offer discounted pilot workshop to existing anchor client (Meridian Analytics) in May rather than holding out for a net-new prospect in June
alternatives_considered: Wait for inbound prospect from conference networking
Run a free beta with a peer's organization
details.rationale: Existing trust reduces delivery risk for first pilot; faster feedback loop supports Q2 target

records.expected_outcome: Workshop pilot completed by 2026-05-28 with NPS ≥ 40 and a reusable curriculum artifact for future sales
